title: Diesel Prices Are About to CRASH… Here’s the Trade I Just Put On
speaker: Ross Givens

macro_themes.view: Drone strikes on Russian refineries and Gulf refinery damage left the world short diesel; US exports ~1.8m bpd to Europe.
Expects a 90-day US diesel export ban before the Nov 3 midterms, pushing US diesel down and European diesel up.
Diesel crack >$100/bbl; a ban would cut refining margins sharply (Valero, Marathon, Phillips 66).

calls.instrument_quoted: ICE Low Sulphur Gasoil futures (IBKR symbol 'G OIL'), $/metric ton
calls.reason: A US diesel export ban removes ~1.8m bpd from the world market, so European diesel (gasoil) should rise while US diesel falls.
calls.quote: that, in all likelihood, makes European diesel go up

calls.instrument_quoted: NYMEX heating oil (ULSD) November futures puts
calls.reason: Export ban keeps US diesel at home, so US diesel price should plummet; bid on Nov HO puts (likely unfilled, illiquid).
calls.quote: if US refiners can't export diesel, the price per gallon here will plummet

notes: Date: host says 'yesterday, on September 23rd' -> recorded Thu 2026-09-24 (listing 09-25). Trade horizon ~6 weeks into midterms. Implied bearish on refiners (VLO, MPC, PSX) margins but no stock call made; not recorded. HO puts orders were resting, likely unfilled.
